attributes.board_name: New Hampshire Board of Mental Health Practice (OPLC)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category A: seminars, workshops or live interactive webinars by a state, regional, national or international professional association relevant to mental health practice; graduate coursework (1 semester hour = 6 CE); teaching; presenting (10); peer-reviewed book (10) or article (6). Category B: other mental-health seminars, publications.
rules.audit_note: Licensees submit the Continuing Education and Collaboration Report Form 200 with renewal and keep documentation (Plc 308.04).

topics.who: Board-approved supervisors: clinical supervision, Category A

rules.legal_basis: N.H. Admin. Rules Mhp 402.01, 402.04; Mhp 401.02; Mhp 403.01 (collaboration)
rules.notes: At least 30 hours Category A; max 10 Category B; home study max 30 hours. Also 40 hours of clinical collaboration every 2 years (Mhp 403.01). License term per Plc 304.12.
